CREATE TABLE migration_runs (
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	counts TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (fingerprint)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin


CREATE TABLE users (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	pw_salt VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pw_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	avatar VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	color VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	name_key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin


CREATE TABLE schemes (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	design LONGTEXT NOT NULL, 
	provenance LONGTEXT, 
	voice_salt BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	created BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin


CREATE TABLE sessions (
	token VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (token), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin


CREATE TABLE works (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	design LONGTEXT NOT NULL, 
	provenance LONGTEXT, 
	parent_id VARCHAR(64), 
	scheme_id VARCHAR(64), 
	created BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin


CREATE TABLE ratings (
	work_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	stars INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (work_id, user_id), 
	CONSTRAINT rating_stars CHECK (stars BETWEEN 1 AND 5), 
	FOREIGN KEY(work_id) REFERENCES works (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_name_key ON users (name_key)
CREATE INDEX schemes_user ON schemes (user_id, updated)
